# SourciaVera

> Independent third-party factory verification and sourcing for auto parts buyers in Latin America, primarily Mexico. Based in Guangzhou, China. We verify wheels, carbon fiber parts, LED lighting, and OEM/ODM private-label auto parts factories before you pay — and the same verification process covers any product category. Pricing starts at $449 per factory verification visit ($399/man-day pre-shipment inspection, $499/man-day factory audit). Reports delivered within 48 hours. Zero factory commissions — we work for buyers only.

- [Auto Parts from China](https://sourciavera.com/categories/auto-parts): Factory verification for wheels, carbon fiber parts, LED lighting, and OEM/ODM private-label auto parts
- [Autopartes desde China](https://sourciavera.com/es/categorias/autopartes): Verificación de fábricas de autopartes — rines, fibra de carbono, iluminación LED y marca propia
- [Construction Materials from China](https://sourciavera.com/categories/construction): Factory verification for container homes, steel structures, and building materials
